notes: Three waws stand against the three written connectives *and*, *both* and *and*, so each takes one (rule 42's counting); rule 14's correlative-pair clause governs one waw rendered by a pair, which is not this case, and the unit's note records the competing reading.
The italic *the way of* is `added`: the verse's דֶּרֶךְ tokens are otherwise rendered by *way* at t003 and *toward* at t018, so no morpheme answers to the supply (rules 30, 7).
כֵּן is the clause's predicate and carries the supplied copula under rule 20, the suffixed nouns taking only their own words.
